title: the great fish
hook: Three days in the belly of the fish.

verses.text: Now the LORD had appointed a great fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah spent three days and three nights in the belly of the fish.

fact: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the LORD his God.

context.text: Now the LORD had appointed a great fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah spent three days and three nights in the belly of the fish.
saying: “In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered me. From the belly of Sheol I called for help, and You heard my voice.
As my life was fading away, I remembered the LORD. My prayer went up to You, to Your holy temple.
